The '''2026 San Diego Super Open Retro Tournament''' was the Retro tournament held at the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]] on 12 April 2026, played in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] by eight players and won by [[Eddie Szwabowski]].<ref name="announce" /><ref name="standings" /><ref name="congrats" /><ref name="recap" /> [[Geoff Bowman]] organized and announced it.<ref name="volunteers" /><ref name="announce" />

On 2 March 2026 the announced plan was one deck for the day.<ref name="samedeck">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1478097369814929448 Same deck for the day], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (2 March 2026).</ref> Two last-minute cancellations kept the field at eight.<ref name="recap" />

== Prizes ==

Announced prize support was $100 for first, $50 for second, and $25 for third and fourth, plus a Premiere dark-side rare uncut sheet for one random player who finished every game.<ref name="prizes">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1478219192585945242 Sunday Retro prize support], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (3 March 2026).</ref> [[Mark Billings]] received that uncut Premiere dark-side rare sheet as the random participation prize.<ref name="recap" /><ref name="names">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1493796740539875458 Group photograph names], redv, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (15 April 2026).</ref> On 2 May 2026, [[Eddie Szwabowski]] said the Players Committee had sent him $100 for the event.<ref name="pc100">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1399484644252057820/1500166395407892560 The PC just sent me $100 for this event], Nrabbit, Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (2 May 2026).</ref>

[[Bren Derlin]] was among those who kept players fed on Sunday. [[Mark Billings]] contributed additional prizes.<ref name="recap" /><ref name="names" />
